name: Telekinetic Slam, Greater
body:
School transmutation; Level magus 4, psychic 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as telekinetic slam except the bludgeoning damage dealt is considered magic for damage reduction purposes and the damage is 1d8 per caster level (maximum 15d8).
